description:
Federal grant opportunities on Grants.gov: open ones soonest closing first (or forecast),
    by words and by who may apply, each with its number, agency, close date, award ceiling and
    estimated funding, and its spendquery.com page, plus up to 5 forecast grants on the same words
    (expected, not yet open). The search wants every word in the listing: with no match it tries
    fewer words and says what it searched for.

q.description: Words in the grant's title or description, e.g. "homelessness" or "rural broadband".
q.title: Q

stage.description: open (taking applications, soonest closing first) or forecast (expected).
stage.title: Stage

who.description: Who may apply: nonprofit, local (cities and counties), state, tribe, university, small_business, business or individual.
who.title: Who

name: grant_opportunities
title: Find federal grant opportunities
